newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Burglars loot S.Africa's Public Protector's home.
newsitem.headline: Burglars loot S.Africa's Public Protector's home.

text.p: Burglars looted the home of South Africa's Public Protector of electrical appliances worth 10,000 rand ($2,300), his office confirmed on Wednesday.
Selby Baqwa's home in Pretoria upmarket Waterkloof Glen suburb was broken into on Tuesday afternoon by burglars who bypassed his alarm system.

"I feel terrible," Baqwa, an appointed watchdog of government affairs, told reporters. "It really drives home that crime in this country has reached a highly unacceptable level...not that I was not aware of it before now."
Murders, car hijackings and drug-related crime have decreased from 1995 but remain high. Police say 1.8 million crimes were reported last year in the country of more than 40 million people.
